mapper.select: SELECT /* selectMasterMpRqSgUserMngList */ A.USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS KEP_USER, B.DEPARTMENT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = B.DEPARTMENT) AS KEP_USER_DEPT, SUM(A.ATT_1) AS QUOTATION_CNT, SUM(A.ATT_2) AS DELAY_CNT, SUM(A.ATT_3) AS LONG_DELAY_CNT, SUM(A.ATT_4) AS NEGO_QUOTATION_CNT, SUM(A.ATT_5), SUM(A.ATT_6) FROM KEP_RQDT_MNG A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.TYPE = B.DEPARTMENT AND A.TYPE = #{st_kep_dept} GROUP BY A.USER_ID, B.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY 2
